widgets.title: Dashboard widgets
widgets.description: Choose what appears on your dashboard, and in what order.

summary.label: Portfolio summary
summary.description: Value, total return, today's change and position count.

quickActions.label: Quick actions
quickActions.description: Record a transaction, a dividend or a cash movement.

performance.label: Performance
performance.description: Time-weighted return over the selected period.

allocation.label: Allocation
allocation.description: How the portfolio is divided, by position, market or tag.

movers.label: Top movers
movers.description: Largest gains and losses among your positions.

goals.label: Goal progress
goals.description: Progress towards the targets you set.

insights.label: Observations
insights.description: Facts about this portfolio, generated by rules.

dividends.label: Dividends
dividends.description: Income received and yield on cost.

transactions.label: Recent transactions
transactions.description: The last few things you recorded.

watchlist.label: Watchlist
watchlist.description: Symbols you are following but do not hold.

pinned.label: Pinned
pinned.description: Whatever you pinned for quick access.

recent.label: Recently viewed
recent.description: The last stocks and portfolios you opened.

dataQuality.label: Data quality
dataQuality.description: Stale prices, missing rates and unresolved imports.

attribution.label: Top contributors
attribution.description: Which holdings added most to the portfolio's return, and which removed most.

events.label: Upcoming events
events.description: Earnings and dividend dates for the instruments you hold or watch.

news.label: News
news.description: Recent coverage of the instruments you hold and watch.

drawdowns.label: Drawdowns
drawdowns.description: How far the portfolio has fallen from its high, and whether it recovered.

metrics.title: Summary metrics
metrics.description: Up to {max} figures, shown at the top of the dashboard.

totalValue.label: Portfolio value
totalValue.definition: Market value of open positions plus cash, in the portfolio's base currency.

investedCapital.label: Invested capital
investedCapital.definition: Cost basis of the shares currently held, buy fees included. Not money deposited.

totalReturnPct.label: Total return
totalReturnPct.definition: Unrealized gain or loss as a percentage of the invested capital of open positions.

todayChange.label: Today's change
todayChange.definition: Change since the previous close, over the holdings that have one. N/A otherwise.

unrealizedPnl.label: Unrealized P&L
unrealizedPnl.definition: Market value minus cost basis for shares still held. Nothing has been booked.

realizedPnl.label: Realized P&L
realizedPnl.definition: Profit and loss booked by shares already sold, fees on both sides included.

dividendIncome.label: Dividend income
dividendIncome.definition: Net dividends received in the last 365 days.

yieldOnCost.label: Yield on cost
yieldOnCost.definition: Trailing twelve-month dividends divided by what the shares cost.

yieldOnValue.label: Yield on current value
yieldOnValue.definition: Trailing twelve-month dividends divided by what the shares are worth today.

cashBalance.label: Cash balance
cashBalance.definition: Deposits minus withdrawals, adjusted for trades and dividends.

cashRatio.label: Cash ratio
cashRatio.definition: Cash as a percentage of total portfolio value.

largestPositionWeight.label: Largest position
largestPositionWeight.definition: The biggest single holding's share of total portfolio value.

positionCount.label: Positions
positionCount.definition: How many instruments are currently held.

metrics.limit: You can choose at most {max} metrics.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Your own labels for holdings. They group and filter; they never change a figure.
tags.name: Tag name
tags.limitReached: You have as many tags as Stockly keeps.
tags.deleteConfirm: Delete this tag? It is removed from every holding it is on.
tags.createHint: Create a tag in Preferences to group these positions your own way.
tags.managerDescription: Your own labels for positions — “Core”, “Dividend”, “High conviction”. They group and filter holdings and never change a figure.

views.title: Saved views
views.description: A filter, a grouping and a sort, saved together.
views.name: View name

pins.limitReached: You have pinned as many items as Stockly keeps.

dismissed.title: Hidden observations
dismissed.description: Observations you dismissed. Restoring one brings it back when its rule next applies.

densityHint: Applies to the holdings, transactions and watchlist tables.
